name: securacv-csi
description: Privacy-preserving WiFi Channel State Information sensing for ESP32-S3. Captures CSI on ESP32/S3/C3 and the C6/C5 Wi-Fi 6 parts (one config shim for both ESP-IDF struct shapes), canonicalizes every frame to the 52 L-LTF tones, keeps the frame supply up with a router echo source, scrubs identifiers at the interrupt boundary, and exports a 32-dim int8 feature vector at 1 Hz covering motion, breathing, RSSI stats, and frame-rate health. Includes a modular sensing pipeline, a privacy-class-tagged event chokepoint, and a 10-minute sliding-window event bundler.
